- Problem: direct plugin installs accept `http://`, `git://`, and `file://` remotes, and marketplace add accepts `http://...git`, with no warning or policy knob. Marketplace entries may pin SHA, but direct source parsing has no immutable pin concept.
- Impact: users can install executable plugin code over unauthenticated transports, making MITM or local path confusion part of the plugin trust surface.
- Concrete fix: default to `https`/SSH only, require an explicit unsafe flag for `http://` and `git://`, and encourage or require full SHA pins for remote plugin installs where possible.

## PLUGIN-R8-03 — Accepted Windows marketplace source derives a rejected name (P3)

Location: `packages/core/src/plugins/parseMarketplaceInput.ts:86`. The parser explicitly accepts drive-prefixed local `.git` paths with forward or backward slashes at line 27. `deriveMarketplaceName` is documented to extract the repository tail, but splits only on `/` and `:`.

The real parser accepts `C:\work\skills.git`; the real deriver returns `\work\skills` rather than `skills`. The same real `assertSafePluginName` used by `marketplaceDir` rejects that name because it contains backslashes. The [parser fixture](evidence/plugins-parser-metadata.test.ts) proves this pure string chain on macOS; `C:/work/skills.git`, POSIX `/tmp/skills.git`, GitHub shorthand and HTTPS `.git` URLs all derive `skills` and pass the guard. Forward slashes are a workaround.

## 7. .cs-meta.json 的 source

远程装时,`installPluginFromPath` 会先把 `source` 写成 realSrc(临时目录,装完即删——无意义)。编排器在装完后**改写** `.cs-meta.json` 的 `source` 为原始 git 串(`parsed.raw`),这样:
- `plugin list` 显示的是 git 地址,不是 `/tmp/...`。
- `plugin update` 能用这个 git 串重新克隆重装(见 §9)。

## 8. 失败模式

| 失败 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| PATH 无 `git` | gitClone 返回 error → 报 "git not available / clone failed: …",删 tmp,不登记 |
| clone 失败(网络/私有库无权限/ref 不存在) | 同上,错误带 git stderr |
| `#subdir` 在仓库里不存在 | 报 "subdir not found in repo: <subdir>",删 tmp |
| 克隆成功但非合法插件 | 走 `installPluginFromPath` 现有校验报错(整装失败),删 tmp |
| 名字已装(§9.1 现状) | `installPluginFromPath` 已有「already installed」拒装 |

所有路径保证:**失败不留半装目录、不留临时目录、不写 installed_plugins.json**。
